Chapter 1106: Chapter 28: The Dazed Thunder Spear Great Honored (Please Subscribe)

Inside the Beta-grade war machines.

Lin Yuan immersed himself in understanding the Chaos Secret Patterns, almost elevating his chaos rule insights every moment.

“It’s too perfect.”

Lin Yuan felt deeply moved; the Chaos Secret Patterns inside the Beta-grade war machines already involved profound aspects of the Second Realm.

“If this pace of comprehension can be maintained, at most a hundred centuries, no—at most a thousand years, and I’ll reach the pinnacle of the Second Realm insights.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As for the Third Realm in chaos?

Currently, the Chaos Secret Patterns contained within the Beta-grade war machines do not cover the essence of the Third Realm’s rules.

Even the Chaos Secrets inside the Alpha-grade war machines likely do not touch upon the Third Realm.

The Third Realm…that is the ultimate realm of chaos rule insights, which many Great Saints in the Chaos Void have yet to achieve.

“Take it slowly, aim for the pinnacle of the Second Realm first.”

Lin Yuan temporarily disregarded the Third Realm in chaos.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s heart suddenly stirred, ceasing his comprehension of the Chaos Secret Patterns, and looking in a certain direction.

“Is the war about to start?”

Lin Yuan directly walked out of the war machine.

At this moment, on the opposite defense line, enemy war machines continuously gathered, and even the aura of a Great Lord was lurking.

“It’s indeed Thunder Spear Great Honored.”

Lin Yuan immediately confirmed the Great Lord opposing them was Thunder Spear Great Honored.

“Thunder Spear Great Honored…he shouldn’t be an ordinary newly ascended Great Lord.” Lin Yuan vaguely sensed that Thunder Spear Great Honored’s aura was deeper than a typical new Great Lord.

“Concealing his strength?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, not particularly concerned.

Thunder Spear Great Honored hid his strength, could it be he hadn’t done the same?

In fact, the strength Lin Yuan concealed was far above that of Thunder Spear Great Honored, even without using ‘Fierce Sun Opening Sky,’ he possessed strengths close to the Great Lord peak battle power.

Swish.

As Lin Yuan gazed upon the battlefield, one by one, heaven-realm experts entered the war machines, slowly activating the massive war machines.

“It’s a shame…can’t leave a single machine behind for comprehension.”

Looking at the war machines ready for battle, Lin Yuan felt slightly disappointed internally.

In every segment of the defense area, the number of war machines was fixed.

Before the war broke out, Lin Yuan hiding inside one of the war machines posed no issues.

But once the battle erupted, if Lin Yuan retained a war machine, it would be too audacious.

The gaze of Red Pine King, though mainly concentrated on the core frontline battlefield, did not mean he ignored other line defenses entirely.

“However, a war continues for several thousand to ten thousand years, with less time spent directly clashing, mainly revolving around regrouping time.”

Lin Yuan contemplated.

The regrouping time referred to when both sides, after fierce battles, plunged into a ceasefire period.

During this period, Lin Yuan would have ample time to slowly comprehend each war machine.

…

“Let Galaxy Great Honored take action first.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored equally kept an eye on the battlefield, seeing war machines activating without the slightest belittling.

Although intelligence showed Galaxy Great Honored was a newly ascended Great Lord, having broken through just over a thousand years ago, marking him as fairly new among new Great Lords.

But Thunder Spear Great Honored, having cultivated to this point, was certainly not overconfident; even though very confident, he still planned to let Galaxy Great Honored act first before deciding whether to intervene.

Seeing Galaxy Great Honored act first essentially meant gaining the upper hand.

…

Soon.

War machines from both sides fell into fierce combat against each other.

Booming sounds.

A chaos-infused fiery war machine suddenly transformed into a gigantic fireball, with endless flames madly spreading in all directions.

“That Beta mid-grade war machine?”

Lin Yuan looked towards this war machine; it was also the highest-grade war machine within this defense area, capable of creating a Fierce Sun domain when fully operated, suppressing all enemy forces within.

Swish.

Over at the Purple Dream Domain, their war machines simultaneously activated, their unleashed power not inferior to Qingfen Domain.

“Lock!”

A gigantic war machine entirely purple in color abruptly took a step forward, instantly causing purple chains to emerge within the void, covering towards Qingfen Domain.

Countless purple chains targeted the only Beta mid-grade war machine on the Qingfen Domain side.

“Not good.”

The single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ changed his expression; he was one of the peak heaven-realm experts controlling the Beta mid-grade war machine.

The Beta mid-grade war machine can host over three thousand heaven-realm experts, but only a few can truly control this war machine.

“Retreat…”

At that moment, the voice suddenly echoed in the single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’s’ ear.

“It’s Great Lord.”

The single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ immediately recognized the voice as belonging to Galaxy Great Honored.

As for its contents, it instructed him on how to repulse the countless purple chains emanating from the coverage.

During this time, although Lin Yuan had not comprehended that Beta mid-grade war machine, through war machines he had already understood, he had ample understanding of it.

This understanding stemmed from the most fundamental comprehension, far surpassing the knowledge of temporary controllers like the single-horned man ‘Luo Peng.’

Therefore, upon seeing the Purple Dream Domain’s war machine releasing numerous purple chains, Lin Yuan instantly realized how to block them.

“Bang!!”

The massive fireball and countless purple chains abruptly collided, causing flames to scatter everywhere, chains to shatter one by one, ultimately forcing the entirely purple war machine from Purple Dream Domain into a helpless retreat.

In the short skirmish just now, it was slightly disadvantaged.

“Thank you, Great Lord.”

Inside the Beta mid-grade war machine, the single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ immediately conveyed his gratitude towards Lin Yuan.

If not for Lin Yuan, under the countless purple chains just now, even if he could manipulate the war machine to break free, he would likely have been restrained for a while.

And with the loss of this war machine’s ‘Fierce Sun Domain’, the Qingfen Domain would lose their greatest advantage in the battlefield’s war machine collisions, and might even face the possibility of collapse.

“Huh?”

“It was blocked?”

Thunder Spear Great Honored was also observing the battlefield, and when he saw the retreat of the purple war machine, his brows furrowed deeply.

The attack of the purple war machine was at his command. Thunder Spear Great Honored thought he had grasped the key to controlling the situation, attacking the moment the Qingfen Domain’s war machine formed the Fierce Sun Domain.

In this way, the odds of victory on his side would increase to the maximum.

“It’s become a stalemate.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored watched the war, observing the battles between war machines on both sides, and felt somewhat restless.

He intended to make a grand display on the battlefield this time, to impress the Spirit Might King.

But according to the current situation, if he didn’t make a move soon, there would be no chance to break through the opponent’s defense.

“Forget it.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored sighed inwardly, originally planning to wait for Galaxy Great Honored to make a move first before acting himself.

Now it seems he has to act on his own.

However, the impact is not significant, as long as intelligence is accurate, Galaxy Great Honored, being a newly ascended Great Honored, posed no certainty of a threat.

Rumble——

Thunder Spear Great Honored’s figure disappeared.

Replaced by an endless expanse of thunder.

The path of Thunder Spear Great Honored was Chaos Thunder, most adept at killing and destruction.

“Thunder Spear Great Honored?”

Lin Yuan appeared silently and blocked Thunder Spear Great Honored, saying, “Your opponent is me.”

“I would like to see what capabilities the disciple handed over by Lord Qingfen possesses.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored was not interested in wasting words. The quicker he breached the defense line of the Qingfen Domain, even just the peripheral one, the better his evaluation from Spirit Might King would be.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan engaged in battle with Thunder Spear Great Honored.

“Focus on defense.”

Lin Yuan only displayed strength equivalent to Thunder Spear Great Honored, as this was also ‘Red Pine King’s strategy.

Whether it was the peripheral defense line where Lin Yuan was located, or the core defense line area, the strategy was all defense-focused, as long as they could withstand the attacks from the Purple Dream Domain.

“Huh?”

After exchanging blows with Lin Yuan for a moment, Thunder Spear Great Honored looked surprised.

He had almost fully unleashed his power, yet still hadn’t managed to drive Lin Yuan back.

“Galaxy Great Honored, have you also hidden your power?”

Thunder Spear Great Honored looked unpleasant, the current scene could only be explained this way.

Lin Yuan did not respond, as part of his attention was focused on the core defense line area, where peak Great Honored were already engaging in confrontation.

“Now it’s troublesome.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored’s expression was heavy.

Originally, he planned to quickly smash Lin Yuan with lightning speed, then break through the defense to leave a good impression on the Spirit Might King.

Spirit Might King is a royal conferred king, whose status is high even if he never becomes an emperor of the Ancient Country in the future. While Heavenly Venerates might not regard him highly, a Great Honored like himself still craves such connections.

But now….. Thunder Spear Great Honored’s internal plans were rapidly collapsing.

“There is still hope to breach the defense line.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored rapidly considered his current options.

“Even though Galaxy Great Honored also concealed some strength, he is similar to me, as long as I…”

Thunder Spear Great Honored glanced downward, where the Purple Dream Domain’s war machines were fiercely clashing with those of the Qingfen Domain.

“As long as I can crush that intermediate-Level-B war machine, gain the advantage on the battlefield below, and then hold off Galaxy Great Honored, I can still breach the defense line.”

He thought to himself.

Originally his plan was to crush Galaxy Great Honored, then go to assist in the war machine clashes below.

Now, it’s unrealistic to rely on himself to smash Galaxy Great Honored, he could only gain the advantage through the war machine clashes below, and then use that to help him.

“Let it be so.”

At Thunder Spear Great Honored’s brows, a brilliant thunder faintly emerged.

Subsequently.

The brilliant thunder tore through time and space, heading towards the battlefield below.

The brilliant thunder suddenly swelled, reaching the height of heaven and earth, its terrifying aura permeating through the layers of space-time, headed towards that intermediate-Level-B war machine.

“This is my Origin Thunderclap, nurtured for millions of years.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored’s aura weakened slightly.

This Origin Thunderclap was Thunder Spear Great Honored’s strongest means of attack, if used against Galaxy Great Honored, it would at most suppress him momentarily, making it difficult to directly smash him.

But if used against the intermediate-Level-B war machine below, it would definitely be able to tear through it.

Once this strongest war machine was taken care of, the battlefield below would definitely see the Purple Dream Domain gain an absolute advantage.

By then, he only needed to hold off Galaxy Great Honored to control the war’s situation.

Buzzing.

The terrifying Origin Thunderclap arrived in an instant, appearing above the intermediate-Level-B war machine as soon as it manifested.

The intermediate-Level-B war machine, though capable of threatening a Great Honored, facing the Great Honored’s strongest attack means, would find it very challenging to withstand, especially with the precise timing of Thunder Spear Great Honored’s Origin Thunderclap.

The intermediate-Level-B war machine had no chance to evade.

“Huh?”

Casually engaging with Thunder Spear Great Honored, Lin Yuan’s expression changed suddenly, looking towards the intermediate-Level-B war machine about to be covered by the terrifying thunder.

“My Chaos Secret Patterns!”

Lin Yuan reached out directly, and in an instant, this hand became enormous beyond measure, tearing through layers of space-time. Thunder Spear Great Honored’s Origin Thunderclap, nurtured for millions of years and regarded as the strongest attack means, was as fragile as paper before Lin Yuan’s right hand, easily torn apart.

The intermediate-Level-B war machine, already swollen to the height of billions of miles, was like a kitten sheltered within Lin Yuan’s outstretched right palm.

“This?”

Thunder Spear Great Honored, who witnessed this scene, fell into silence immediately.
